label: 1 · Roll & scan
title: Case 1, roll & scan: the left arm rolls the bag label-up, the handheld scanner (phone in the left claw) reads it, the harness routes it, WALLX puts it into the scanned box with the right arm

steps.title: Roll the bag label-up
steps.prompt: Left arm: pick up the bag, turn it over, set it down label up.

steps.title: Left claw opens for the phone
steps.prompt: Left arm: open the claw.

steps.title: Load the phone
steps.prompt: Put the phone in the LEFT claw now (5 s).

steps.title: Grip the phone
steps.prompt: Close until the fingers touch the phone, then a little firmer.

steps.title: Hold the phone over the bag
steps.prompt: Left arm: hold the phone over the label.

steps.title: The phone scans the label; the harness routes the code
steps.prompt: Read the label with the handheld scanner, choose the zone.
steps.detail: No scan in 3 min → no zone guessed, arms home.

steps.title: Left arm home with the phone
steps.prompt: Left arm: back to rest, keep the phone.

steps.title: Find the bag on the camera and pick it up (right arm)
steps.prompt: Find the bag, move above it, open, down, close, lift.

steps.title: WALLX puts the bag into the scanned zone (right arm)
steps.detail: Prompt: “Use the right arm to put the white bag you are holding into zone {zone}.” Stopped only when the arm is at that box (or the bag is seen in it).

steps.title: Release
steps.prompt: Open the claw and lift.

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; take the phone out.

label: 2 · Phone scanner
title: Case 2, handheld scanner: the left hand holds the phone and scans the label; the harness routes the code; WALLX sorts the parcel with the right hand

steps.title: Keep holding the phone (left claw stays closed)
steps.prompt: Left claw: keep the phone, no opening.

steps.title: Left hand holds the phone over the parcel
steps.prompt: Left arm: hold the phone over the parcel's label.

steps.title: The phone scans the label; the harness routes the code
steps.prompt: Read the label with the handheld scanner, choose the zone.
steps.detail: The phone (3x) sends frames to the dashboard, which decodes the barcode / QR / pincode; the harness routes it (940/941/950/951 → zone 1, 900-902 → zone 2, else zone 3) and writes the zone into the WALLX sentence. The arms hold until a scan arrives.

steps.title: Left arm home quickly (scan done)
steps.prompt: Left arm: straight back to rest, keep the phone.
steps.detail: As soon as the harness has the code, the left arm goes home so the right arm can start.

steps.title: Find the parcel on the camera and pick it up there
steps.prompt: Find the parcel on the head camera, move above it, open, go down, close tight, lift.
steps.detail: Pixel → arm position from the head camera; works wherever the parcel is.

steps.title: WALLX carries the parcel into the scanned zone
steps.detail: Right arm; the left (phone) arm is locked.

steps.title: Release the parcel
steps.prompt: Open the right claw and lift straight up.

steps.title: Right arm home
steps.prompt: Right arm: go to rest.

steps.title: Left arm home with the phone
steps.prompt: Left arm: back to rest, keep holding the phone.
steps.detail: The phone stays gripped; take it out after the run.

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call and the log are saved.

label: 7 · Handover (bonus)
title: Case 7 (bonus), handover in the air: the right arm picks the Bhindi box and hands it to the left arm; WALLX puts it into zone 1

steps.title: Read the label, route to zone 1
steps.detail: Barcode reader first, pincode OCR reader as fallback. Code 420/95126/001 = pincode 951 → zone 1 → left arm.
steps.what: label → lane → acting arm → target zone
steps.prompt: Read the label with the barcode reader (pincode OCR reader as fallback), choose the zone and the arm.

steps.title: Pick + handover
steps.detail: the right arm picks the box and hands it to the left claw in the air.

sub.text: right arm moves from home to above the box (claw closed)
right claw opens and lowers around the box
right claw closes on the box (grasp)
right arm lifts the box to the handover point (~18 cm up, table centre)
left claw opens and reaches in
left claw closes on the box: both claws hold it
right claw opens: the box is in the left claw only

steps.prompt: Right arm: pick up the purple box and hand it to the left arm in the air.

steps.title: Right arm backs off
steps.detail: Move (≤ 4 cm per call): right claw lifts and moves away to (0.35, 0.20, 0.26) m so it cannot hit the box or the left arm.
steps.prompt: Right arm: let go and move up and away from the box.

steps.title: Right arm home
steps.detail: Home, claw closed. From here the right arm stays parked.
steps.prompt: Right arm: go to rest.

steps.title: WALLX places the box into zone 1 (left arm)
steps.prompt: Stretch to the top left corner of the table and put the purple box into zone 1.
steps.detail: WALLX (wall-x 2610-dualhead-v2, organisers' server) gets the HEAD camera image (the harness sends black wrist images: the held box blocks the left wrist camera, so it only confuses WALLX) + both arms' state + this sentence every call, and returns an action chunk for both arms. The harness LOCKS the right arm (its WALLX actions are replaced by 'hold still'), runs 40% of each chunk per call (--slow 0.4, smoother and safer), and keeps the same sub-goal across calls (--no-reset-on-subgoal). 40 calls. WALLX alone decides where to move, how to lower and where to set the box down.

steps.title: Release
steps.detail: The left claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm straight up, so the box stays inside zone 1.
steps.prompt: Open the claw fully and lift straight up.

steps.title: Both arms home
steps.detail: Both arms go to rest (≤ 5 cm per call).
steps.prompt: Both arms: go to rest.

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call (state, actions, images) and the log are saved.

WALLX alone does the grasp, the lift, the carry and the set-down.

steps.title: Release
steps.detail: The acting claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm straight up.
steps.prompt: Open the claw fully and lift straight up.

steps.title: WALLX picks up the hat and puts it into the right corner bin
steps.detail: WALLX does all the motion (head camera + both gripper cameras, left arm locked, 230 calls at 30% speed, one prompt). The harness keeps watching the cap on its grid every call: when the cap sits in a NEW cell for 3 calls, the prompt is cancelled, WALLX's history is reset and WALLX starts the task again from the hat's new spot. When WALLX starts to close the claw, the harness first takes the open claw down to grab height (no depth camera on this robot). Red marks on the timeline = re-targets.
